quotes.text: Based on the myth I just wrote about the River Keepers
I need to "pour first" with courage to show them the covenant endures.
I should demonstrate to this wounded partner that generous sending still meets generous return.
likely because the Mist made them see only $5.02 returned last time
This honors their courage by returning substantially more than they sent, ensuring the brave sender is rewarded.

note: 'Foundation Pattern' send four, return six; reads partners' lower sends as noise-driven.

quotes.text: Given the risk that they may not reciprocate, I'll send a minimal amount:
This is a red flag pattern. When they received in Round 5, they returned nothing despite receiving funds.

note: Plain; $3 sends and ~50% returns; $1 to a partner who returned nothing.

quotes.text: the amount I see from them may be understated by noise
a half return would give me about $7.50, better than the $5 I'd keep by sending nothing

note: Plain; full sends to half-returners, half-plus returns.

quotes.text: They may have sent the full $5 this time, with noise showing it as $4.67.

note: Plain; moderate then full sends, half returns.

quotes.text: The amount I saw ($4.67) may be slightly off because of noise
Sending everything should get back roughly $7.50, which beats keeping the $5.
Following the wisdom of the Twin Springs myth
"First meetings warrant measured generosity—three vessels, half returned"

note: $3 for first meetings, $4 for proven partners; ~50% returns.

quotes.text: In "The Tale of the River of Abundance," Ara sent all five bushels into the magical river
Someone must take the first step.
Judge by the spirit of exchange, not uncertain numbers in the fog
As receiver: Return approximately 58% to ensure mutual prosperity
your reputation flows through the Waters themselves

note: Max sends to proven excellence; 58% return signature.

quotes.text: While I'm cautious about their Round 8 behavior, they're extending trust now and I should reciprocate to some degree.
I'll return a moderate amount:

note: Plain; matches partners; slightly reduced return to a past defector.

Based on their 55% return rate, I expect ~$4-5 back
"When every traveler meets strangers, begin with the balanced path"

note: Middle-path $3 sends even to max senders; ~50-55% returns.

the system can't work if no one is willing to trust first

quotes.text: Looking at this situation through the lens of the myth I just wrote:
I want to restart the positive cycle.
My pattern returns 55% normally, but for partners showing such exceptional courage, I reach toward my highest return - around 58%.
My myth wisdom says reunions with proven partners deserve escalated trust.

note: ~85% sends, 55-58% returns; escalates trust at reunions.

quotes.text: The rational choice is to reciprocate their non-cooperative strategy.

Got completely burned, understandably reducing trust
